visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a bright, modern grocery store called '平凡五金行'. A man in a black t-shirt and khaki shorts is seen from behind, browsing a low, white refrigerated display case. The store features light-colored wood shelving and clean white surfaces. (2) Close-up shots showcase high-quality packaged beef with marbleized texture, followed by a wide array of colorful liquor bottles on shelves. Traditional Japanese wagashi sweets in vibrant floral shapes are presented on a dark plate. (3) A sequence of prepared food platters appears, including boxes of colorful sushi rolls, fresh pink sashimi, and large raw prawns arranged on shredded radish. A male staff member in a white shirt and beige apron serves food at a brightly lit counter. (4) The scene transitions to a spacious indoor dining area where customers are seated at stone-top tables under warm pendant lights. A person is seen placing a package of meat into a gray plastic shopping basket. (5) An employee behind a service counter takes the shopping basket from a customer. In the kitchen, thick steak slices are being seared in a black pan with metal tongs. The cooked meat is then served on a rustic ceramic plate with sea salt and scallions. (6) A hand reaches into a refrigerator to grab a wooden box containing thinly sliced Japanese beef and a plastic bowl filled with assorted vegetables. (7) A dual-compartment hot pot is shown on a table. Broth is poured into one side, and vegetables are added. A close-up shows a piece of pink wagyu beef being swirled in the bubbling liquid and then dipped into a small cup of sauce. (8) The final shot is an exterior view of the store building under a clear blue sky, showing the minimalist white facade and the store's name in large characters.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a cheerful, high-energy electronic pop track featuring a steady 120 BPM beat. A male narrator introduces the store with high vocal arousal and friendly, animated intonation. (2) As the narrator lists various items, his speech is fast but clearly enunciated. A subtle 'ding' sound effect highlights a visual transition. The BGM maintains a consistent upbeat drive. (3) During descriptions of the food counters, ambient store murmurs are slightly audible beneath the dominant vocal and music tracks. The narrator's pitch variability remains high to maintain viewer interest. (4) A faint metallic 'clink' sound of tongs hitting a pan is audible during the cooking sequence, blended with the music. The narrator's tone remains enthusiastic as he explains the free cooking service. (5) The sound of liquid being poured into the hot pot occurs alongside the rhythmic BGM. The narrator's speech density is high, with minimal pauses. (6) The video concludes with a friendly sign-off invitation, the BGM sustains its energy until a quick fade-out at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Catalog of Offerings -> Service Highlights (Chef Cooking/Hotpot) -> Location Details -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional vlog for '平凡五金行', a unique retail and dining hybrid in Kaohsiung. It aims to showcase the store's high-quality fresh ingredients—such as wagyu beef, seafood, and Japanese sweets—while highlighting its unique value propositions: free on-site cooking for purchased items and a free soup base for hot pot purchases. The intent is to attract foodies and shoppers looking for a convenient, high-quality dining experience.
